decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 (2026-07-10) shows real intent, but no invites and no reply to three outreach emails (email:c1e6d175, email:09e29684, email:593a35d7) suggests stalled engagement. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some room; no tickets means no blocker signal either way.

draft.subject: One next step for Harbor Collective
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

You've got your first project in place, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything open.

Best,
Priya
